title: Transport of the two factor units under first-factor open base change
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, F an O_X-module, G an O_Y-module and V an open of X. Let b:V×_kY→X×_kY be the cartesian map induced by V→X and id_Y, p,q the original projections and pV,qV the local projections. The inverse image under b of p inverse-image V is top and p inverse-image V is contained in the range of b. There is a scalar-linear isomorphism eF:F(V)≅Γ(V,F restricted to V), and coefficient isomorphisms eM:b* p*F≅pV*(F restricted to V) and eN:b* q*G≅qV*G. For each s∈F(V), applying eM to the b-unit of the p-unit of s, restricted to the top, gives the pV-global-unit of eF(s). For each t∈Γ(Y,G), applying eN to the b-unit of the q-global-unit of t restricted to p inverse-image V, and then restricting to the top, gives the qV-global-unit of t. The section units and scalar objects use [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] and [lem-sc-scalar-open-tensor-transport]. No tensor product of coefficients or of sections occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Construct b by pullback.map. It is an open immersion. The cartesian first-leg square identifies its opensRange with p inverse-image V. The projection equation b≫p=pV≫V.ι identifies the inverse image of this open with the top open. Construct eF from the restriction adjunction unit, restriction to the top, and scalar linearity of a unit over Spec k. Uniqueness of left adjoints and the standard open-immersion unit prove this map bijective.

For the first factor, take the conjugate isomorphism of the right-adjoint comparison pushforward pV followed by pushforward V.ι ≅ pushforward b followed by pushforward p. Its left-adjoint mate is tensorPullback p followed by tensorPullback b ≅ restriction V.ι followed by tensorPullback pV. For the second factor, use b≫q=qV and the conjugate of pushforward qV ≅ pushforward b followed by pushforward q. Evaluate these comparisons on F and G to obtain eM and eN.

Evaluate unit_conjugateEquiv_symm for each comparison at V (first factor) or top (second factor). On the first factor, naturality of eM and of the pV-unit moves restriction to the top past the coefficient map and the local unit. On the second factor, naturality of the b-unit moves the restriction of the q-unit past that unit; naturality of eN then gives the global qV-unit. All remaining compositions are restriction maps for equal morphisms in the thin category of opens, so functoriality identifies them. Empty opens and zero coefficients obey the same equations.

theorem exists_externalOpenFactorUnitsLeft
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (V : X.Opens) :
    ∃ hTop : ⊤ ≤ externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V ⁻¹ᵁ (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V),
    ∃ _hRange : pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ (externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V).opensRange,
    ∃ eF : scalarObj f F (op V) ≅ scalarObj (V.ι ≫ f) (F.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤),
    ∃ eM : (tensorPullback (externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V)).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) ≅
        (tensorPullback (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ f) g)).obj (F.restrict V.ι),
    ∃ eN : (tensorPullback (externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V)).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) ≅
        (tensorPullback (pullback.snd (V.ι ≫ f) g)).obj G,
      (∀ s : scalarObj f F (op V),
        eM.hom.app ⊤ (tensorPullbackOpenSection (externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V)
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V) hTop
          (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.fst f g))).unit.app
            F).val.app (op V) s)) =
          tensorPullbackTopSection (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ f) g) (F.restrict V.ι) (eF.hom s)) ∧
      (∀ t : scalarObj g G (op ⊤),
        eN.hom.app ⊤ (tensorPullbackOpenSection (externalOpenBaseChangeLeft f g V)
          ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V) hTop
          (((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G).val.map
            (homOfLE (by simp : pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
              G).val.app (op ⊤) t))) =
          tensorPullbackTopSection (pullback.snd (V.ι ≫ f) g) G t)
